u0: Progress: the ball is already clear of the door cell, but the agent has not yet secured the matching key. This is the starting task state: no key in hand, door still locked, target untouched. Objective: locate the key in the starting room, approach it, and pick it up without taking the ball (it can remain where it lies). Only once the agent is holding the door-colored key, with the door still closed, can progress advance.
u1: Progress: the agent is holding the key that matches the locked door, the front-of-door cell remains free, and the door is still closed. Objective: walk to the cell in front of the locked door, face it, and toggle it open. The key must stay in hand through this unlock step; losing it back to the floor before the door opens would drop the task into the loss-recovery state.
u2: Progress: the door has been unlocked and opened, and the agent has not yet picked up the mission box. Objective: enter the room beyond the open door, locate the designated mission box, and pick it up. If the key is still carried, hands must be freed first by dropping it (avoiding dropping it onto the front-of-door cell). Do not toggle the door closed again, as that would regress progress.
u3: Progress: the matching key was previously held but has been dropped or lost while the door remains closed, a setback state. Objective: recover by finding and picking up the matching key again, then either reopen the still-closed door if not open, or proceed through it if it happens to be open. Once the key is back in hand, resume the unlock or collect flow depending on door status.
u4: Progress: the mission is complete; the agent has picked up the designated target box. Terminal success state: the episode ends on this pickup, so no further objectives remain and the task is finished.
